title: THE WOMAN WHO STOLE EVERY DOOR
deck: Kez can remove any opening from matter, and during a coup she seals an entire capital to keep its people safe. With a hospital running out of oxygen, Illuminara has forty minutes to prove that shelter does not have to become a prison — if the people inside own the threshold.
shape: Seven scenes across one sealed day: an airless hospital, the remembered slit that changes the question, a threshold tested under fire, a city of inside keepers, a commander offered a smaller honest door, a ceasefire chosen through it, and rain entering a greenhouse by permission.

scenes.title: No Way In
paragraphs: *Marden capital · Central Mercy Hospital plaza · minute zero*
Every door in the capital had become a wall at 06:17.

Central Mercy still carried the bronze letters EMERGENCY, but seamless stone covered its entrance and windows. Two million people were sealed into rooms, trains and towers while coup and loyalist forces faced one another in streets neither side could enter. No bullet crossed a wall. Neither did air.

**Daro**  
Thirty-seven minutes before this ward reaches unsafe oxygen. Less in neonatal care.
A rifle round struck Illuminara's field over the medics and engineers. Kez appeared on every emergency screen, dust whitening her black coat.

**Kez**  
Nobody has been shot inside a room since I closed the city.

**Illuminara**  
Nobody can breathe inside this hospital for much longer.

**Kez**  
You can guard a corridor because bullets cannot hurt you. When you leave, ordinary people pay for your faith in openings.
It was not a foolish objection. Illuminara could hold the plaza, or fold her protection inward to carry only herself through the wall. She could not do both.

**Illuminara**  
Daro, move the ambulances behind the transit pillar. Do not cut again. Let the people inside tell us what they need.

**Daro**  
Three minutes. After that, the plaza is hers.
Illuminara dropped the wide shield. Gunfire struck empty pavement as the ambulances reversed. With protection folded close around her body, she passed alone into the hospital.

scenes.title: The Ward Without Air
paragraphs: *Central Mercy · respiratory ward · minute six*
The ward smelled of antiseptic, hot plastic and too many breaths. Dr Ansa Vale had gathered thirty patients in its largest room and lined the remaining oxygen cylinders between their beds.

**Ansa**  
If you came to break us out, ask first. Armed men are waiting on both sides.

**Illuminara**  
I came to listen first.
Lio, Kez's younger brother, lifted two fingers beneath an oxygen hood.

**Lio**  
She told you about the cellar door.

**Illuminara**  
She said it held.

**Lio**  
That is the short version.

During the childhood siege, a militia had owned the shelter door. When it came for their mother, Kez removed the doorway and made the cellar whole. The wall kept the militia out and trapped forty-one people with one blocked vent.

**Lio**  
You made a slit near the ceiling. Mara Fen opened it when we said yes—every ten breaths—then closed it again.

**Kez**  
A sniper killed our mother through the courtyard gate the next morning.

**Lio**  
A gate the militia owned. Not the slit Mara owned from inside.
Lio's fingertips opened on the tenth breath. Illuminara looked from his hand to the old mechanical symbols on Ansa's building plan.

**Illuminara**  
What in this building still turns by hand from the sheltered side?

**Ansa**  
The ambulance-bay fire shutters. Two wheels, both inside.

**Illuminara**  
Kez, do not give the city its doors back. Give this ward one opening it owns.

**Kez**  
An opening is a weapon with two ends.

**Ansa**  
Then let us hold the end beside the patients.

scenes.title: The First Threshold
paragraphs: *Central Mercy · former ambulance bay · minute thirteen*

Daro found the two steel shutters six metres apart. If Kez restored their openings one at a time, the bay could become an airlock. The inside wheels would stay beyond any remote command or arriving gun.

**Daro**  
Outer shutter first. We build a shielded well around it. The inner shutter stays wall until the well is sealed.

**Kez**  
And when soldiers seize your well?

**Daro**  
They still cannot turn Ansa's wheel.
Ansa asked every conscious patient whether to try. Two said no. She moved them behind a second fire wall and counted again; everyone remaining raised a hand.

**Ansa**  
The ward chooses yes. We close it ourselves if the test fails.
Kez restored the outer opening. Gunfire hit before Daro's crew seated the last plate. A round crossed the upper seam and shattered a lamp. Glass cut his arm, but he held the brace.

**Kez**  
That is what a door means.

**Daro**  
No. That was an unfinished wall. Give me ninety seconds and the right to say when it is ready.
A medic wrapped him while the crew raised the last angled plate. Mirrors showed anyone approaching without exposing the ward.
At Daro's signal, Kez restored the opening. Ansa turned the inner wheel, and fresh air entered the lock.
A man in a medic's coat ran from the arcade with a red hospital badge. Ansa checked the live list; the badge belonged to a nurse beside her.

**Ansa**  
Refused.
She closed the inner shutter before the crew opened the outer one. The false medic found an empty chamber and four civilian cameras.

**Illuminara**  
The opening did not decide. The people it sheltered did.
Kez released the inner aperture again. Air moved through filters chosen inside the ward. Lio's next breath ended in a startled laugh, and Illuminara only listened.

scenes.title: A City of Keepers
paragraphs: *Marden emergency network · minute twenty-one*

Central Mercy had not solved Marden. It had proved one mechanism could survive a refusal. Daro sent its measurements across the city; residents named local keepers and engineers ranked air and fire risk.

**Kez**  
Which one first—the nursery or the tower? If I choose wrong, your rule still has my hand on it.

**Illuminara**  
The people inside report their need and their working controls. Daro publishes the order. You choose only whether to honour it.

**Lio**  
You may refuse, but you tell them why, and they answer.
A textile tower received one roof vent. Courthouse civilians rejected the loyalist demand for a front entrance and received roof air instead.

A coup-held broadcast hall claimed six hundred hostages. Its roster, exposed when cleaner Aru Pell held up two fingers and pointed down, showed 584 staff and family members on the lower floors and sixteen armed fighters above them.

**Illuminara**  
Keep air, water and medicine moving. Restore the basement duct if the civilians ask. Let the laundry-yard neighbours build one exit they own.

The civilians voted through a maintenance terminal. Kez restored the duct for air while the neighbours fitted a double hatch: weapons into a sealed trough, empty hands at the camera, then a person-width door opened from the yard. Aru painted a green line beside it.
Every restored threshold carried Kez's name, its inside keeper and a recorded reason. Her gift was no longer the only authority on the map.

scenes.title: The Corridor Nobody Could Take
paragraphs: *Marden civic hospital corridor · minute twenty-nine*
Resident-owned thresholds denied both armies their shortcuts. Commander Rusk offered Kez permanent command of every entrance if she opened one corridor from the treasury to the river.

**Rusk**  
No child will wait for a vote while a soldier comes through the window.

**Kez**  
And who owns the key to me?

**Rusk**  
Nobody. That is the point.
His offer removed the chance that anyone could command Kez and left everyone else inside a refuge that could become her cell.

**Illuminara**  
I named what you felt before. I was wrong. Tell me what his offer gets wrong.

**Kez**  
Mara could close the slit. Rusk would never let her touch it.
Kez faced the commander herself.

**Kez**  
The river corridor stays wall. At the laundry door, weapons go through the trough and people leave one at a time into safe civilian custody. Water and medicine come whether you accept or not. Loyalists get the same terms.

**Rusk**  
You would make soldiers ask cleaners for permission to walk.

**Kez**  
We ask the people whose rooms we turned into routes. I will use their door too when this is over.

**Rusk**  
You will stand trial beside them.

**Kez**  
Yes.
She published every opening she had removed, including forty-three occupied rooms unknown to emergency services, and restored only routes whose inside keepers confirmed readiness.
Illuminara held one evacuation line while local teams worked. She did not open a threshold herself. The system no longer required her—or Kez—to be everywhere.

scenes.title: Open by Choice
paragraphs: *Marden capital · minute thirty-eight through midday*

At minute thirty-eight, Central Mercy reached safe oxygen reserve. Daro returned with his cut arm braced. Ansa would not let him lift a plate; he touched the finished upper seam with his good hand and found it holding.
Seventy-three civilian corridors now linked hospitals, shelters, kitchens and water stations. Each could be closed from inside without Kez or Illuminara.
At 07:41, Aru counted the 584th civilian out of the broadcast hall. Only then did he turn the camera toward Rusk.

**Aru**  
You said no child should wait while a soldier comes through a window. This bolt is inside. A soldier at the window cannot reach it.

**Rusk**  
What if your keeper is the threat?

**Aru**  
Two named keepers, a public camera and either one may stop the door. Watch us prove it before you choose.

One fighter pushed his rifle into the trough. Aru angled the camera toward the fighter's empty hands. The neighbours opened, accepted him into civilian custody and did not strike him; the inner bolt held throughout.

Rusk watched three more fighters choose the same passage. Then he set down his pistol, looked at the bolt no arriving soldier could reach, and walked through the smaller door. The others followed by their own turns. Loyalist units received and used the same terms under their own civilian monitors.

Rescuers also reached Jessa Tol, alone in one of the forty-three rooms. She chose AIR ONLY and refused a doorway until neighbours fitted an inside bolt. After closing it once herself, she asked them to open again.
By midday, both commands had accepted a civilian ceasefire line. Food, water and medicine had never depended on disarmament; the fighting ended through a safe route each person could choose.
Kez came to Central Mercy on foot. Ansa kept the inner shutter closed until Kez showed both hands to the camera.

**Ansa**  
You confined everyone here without asking. You may see Lio. You may not decide when this door opens again.

**Kez**  
Agreed.
Ansa turned the wheel. Kez sat beside Lio without touching his controls.

**Lio**  
The cellar door did hold.

**Kez**  
So did the slit.

**Lio**  
You remembered both.

**Kez**  
Not soon enough.

**Illuminara**  
Soon enough for the hospital. Not soon enough to erase what you did.

Kez asked that the two patients who had refused the first test keep their doors absent. Civilian recorders took her map and the military broadcasts. Her tribunal would begin after recovery; nobody she endangered had to praise the person who returned their air.

scenes.title: The Greenhouse Door
paragraphs: *Marden south district · community greenhouse · next dawn*
A carpenter fitted a mechanical frame where the greenhouse doors had vanished. Its bolt was inside.
Kez looked to twelve-year-old Tavi Sol, the elected keeper, and waited.

**Tavi**  
Now.
Kez restored the opening. Tavi closed and opened the door twice to prove the choice remained hers. No army crossed; children carried seedlings into the light.
Kez had not been absolved or made keeper of every future door. She had returned a power she took and accepted a city where other hands could refuse hers.
Illuminara lifted the last tray with Tavi. The tomato vines had bent during the sealed day but had not broken.

**Tavi**  
Should we leave it open?

**Illuminara**  
You tell me.
Tavi felt the wind, looked at the clouds and left the door open for the rain.

critic_line: Illuminara trades the plaza shield for a hand-turned wheel inside a failing ward, and a city sealed by one woman's gift reopens door by door, each bolt on the inside, until a coup commander walks through the smaller door by choice and a twelve-year-old leaves the greenhouse open for rain.

shared_strengths: Strong high-concept premise (a power that removes every door) with a humane thesis that shelter must be owned by those inside. The ticking oxygen clock and the cellar-door backstory pull readers in. But the middle becomes procedural, with many minor named characters and a resolution that goes too smoothly.

The central idea—safety through consent and locally controlled thresholds—is humane, clear, and satisfyingly dramatized through dialogue and escalating tests. The oxygen deadline sustains momentum, while Kez’s accountability prevents easy absolution. Some readers may find the later civic procedures schematic and the resolution unusually comprehensive, reducing emotional spontaneity.
shared_reservations: No separate improvement instruction was provided beyond Claude’s attributed reader explanation.

translation_sl.title: ŽENSKA, KI JE UKRADLA VSA VRATA
translation_sl.deck: Kez lahko iz snovi odstrani vsako odprtino in med državnim udarom zapečati celotno prestolnico, da bi ohranila njene prebivalce varne. Ker bolnišnici zmanjkuje kisika, ima Illuminara štirideset minut, da dokaže, da zavetje ni nujno zapor — če prag pripada ljudem v njem.
translation_sl.shape: Sedem prizorov v enem zapečatenem dnevu: bolnišnica brez zraka, spomin na režo, ki spremeni vprašanje, prag, preizkušen pod ognjem, mesto notranjih varuhov, poveljnik, ki dobi manjša poštena vrata, premirje, izbrano skoznje, in dež, ki z dovoljenjem vstopi v rastlinjak.

scenes.title: Ni poti noter
paragraphs: *Prestolnica Marden · trg pred bolnišnico Central Mercy · ničta minuta*
Ob 06.17 so vsa vrata v prestolnici postala zid.

Central Mercy je še vedno nosila bronaste črke URGENCA, vendar je njen vhod in okna prekrival brezšivni kamen. Dva milijona ljudi je bilo zapečatenih v sobe, vlake in stolpe, medtem ko so si sile državnega udara in lojalisti stali nasproti na ulicah, na katere nobena stran ni mogla vstopiti. Nobena krogla ni prečkala zidu. Tudi zrak ne.

**Daro**  
Sedemintrideset minut, preden bo kisik na tem oddelku nevarno nizek. Na neonatalnem še manj.
Puškin naboj je zadel Illuminareno zaščitno polje nad reševalci in inženirji. Kez se je pojavila na vseh zaslonih za nujne primere, njen črni plašč je belil prah.

**Kez**  
Odkar sem zaprla mesto, v nobeni sobi niso nikogar ustrelili.

**Illuminara**  
V tej bolnišnici kmalu nihče več ne bo mogel dihati.

**Kez**  
Hodnik lahko varuješ, ker te krogle ne morejo poškodovati. Ko odideš, navadni ljudje plačajo za tvojo vero v odprtine.
To ni bil neumen ugovor. Illuminara je lahko zadržala trg ali pa svojo zaščito skrčila k sebi, da bi skozi zid prenesla le sebe. Obojega ni mogla.

**Illuminara**  
Daro, premakni reševalna vozila za steber postaje. Ne režite več. Naj nam ljudje v notranjosti povedo, kaj potrebujejo.

**Daro**  
Tri minute. Potem trg pripada njej.
Illuminara je spustila široki ščit. Streli so udarili v prazen pločnik, ko so reševalna vozila zapeljala vzvratno. Z zaščito, tesno zvito okoli svojega telesa, je sama prešla skozi zid v bolnišnico.

scenes.title: Oddelek brez zraka
paragraphs: *Central Mercy · respiratorni oddelek · šesta minuta*
Oddelek je dišal po razkužilu, vroči plastiki in preveč vdihih. Dr. Ansa Vale je zbrala trideset bolnikov v največji sobi, preostale jeklenke s kisikom pa razvrstila med njihove postelje.

**Ansa**  
Če ste prišli, da bi nas spravili ven, najprej vprašajte. Oboroženi možje čakajo na obeh straneh.

**Illuminara**  
Najprej sem prišla poslušat.
Lio, Kezin mlajši brat, je pod kisikovo kapo dvignil dva prsta.

**Lio**  
Povedala ti je za vrata kleti.

**Illuminara**  
Rekla je, da so zdržala.

**Lio**  
To je kratka različica.

Med obleganjem v otroštvu je vrata zaklonišča obvladovala milica. Ko je prišla po njuno mater, je Kez odstranila vhod in klet spremenila v celoto. Zid je zadržal milico zunaj in ujel enainštirideset ljudi ob enem zamašenem zračniku.

**Lio**  
Pri stropu si naredila režo. Mara Fen jo je odprla, ko smo privolili — vsakih deset vdihov — in jo nato spet zaprla.

**Kez**  
Naslednje jutro je ostrostrelec skozi dvoriščna vrata ubil najino mater.

**Lio**  
Skozi vrata, ki jih je obvladovala milica. Ne skozi režo, ki jo je Mara obvladovala od znotraj.
Lijeve konice prstov so se ob desetem vdihu razprle. Illuminara je pogledala z njegove roke na stare mehanske oznake na Ansinem načrtu stavbe.

**Illuminara**  
Kaj v tej stavbi se še vedno vrti ročno z zaščitene strani?

**Ansa**  
Požarne pregrade v reševalnem dovozu. Dve kolesi, obe znotraj.

**Illuminara**  
Kez, mestu ne vračaj njegovih vrat. Daj temu oddelku eno odprtino, ki mu pripada.

**Kez**  
Odprtina je orožje z dvema koncema.

**Ansa**  
Potem pa naj konec ob bolnikih držimo mi.

scenes.title: Prvi prag
paragraphs: *Central Mercy · nekdanji reševalni dovoz · trinajsta minuta*

Daro je našel dve jekleni pregradi, oddaljeni šest metrov. Če bi Kez njuni odprtini obnovila eno za drugo, bi dovoz lahko postal zračna zapora. Notranji kolesi bi ostali zunaj dosega vsakršnega daljinskega ukaza ali prihajajočega orožja.

**Daro**  
Najprej zunanja pregrada. Okoli nje zgradimo zaščiten jašek. Notranja pregrada ostane zid, dokler jašek ni zatesnjen.

**Kez**  
In ko vojaki zavzamejo vaš jašek?

**Daro**  
Še vedno ne morejo zavrteti Ansinega kolesa.
Ansa je vsakega zavestnega bolnika vprašala, ali naj poskusijo. Dva sta rekla ne. Premaknila ju je za drugi požarni zid in ponovno preštela; vsi preostali so dvignili roko.

**Ansa**  
Oddelek je izbral da. Če preizkus ne uspe, ga zapremo sami.

Kez je obnovila zunanjo odprtino. Streli so zadeli, preden je Darova ekipa namestila zadnjo ploščo. Naboj je prečkal zgornjo špranjo in razbil svetilko. Steklo mu je zarezalo v roko, vendar je obdržal oporo.

**Kez**  
To pomenijo vrata.

**Daro**  
Ne. To je bil nedokončan zid. Daj mi devetdeset sekund in pravico, da povem, kdaj je pripravljen.
Zdravnik ga je obvezal, medtem ko je ekipa dvignila zadnjo nagnjeno ploščo. Ogledala so kazala vsakogar, ki se je približeval, ne da bi izpostavila oddelek.
Na Darov znak je Kez obnovila odprtino. Ansa je zavrtela notranje kolo in svež zrak je vstopil v zaporo.
Moški v zdravniškem plašču je pritekel iz arkade z rdečo bolnišnično značko. Ansa je preverila sprotni seznam; značka je pripadala medicinski sestri ob njej.

**Ansa**  
Zavrnjeno.
Notranjo pregrado je zaprla, preden je ekipa odprla zunanjo. Lažni zdravnik se je znašel pred prazno komoro in štirimi civilnimi kamerami.

**Illuminara**  
Odprtina ni odločila. Odločili so ljudje, ki jih je varovala.
Kez je znova sprostila notranjo odprtino. Zrak je tekel skozi filtre, izbrane znotraj oddelka. Lijev naslednji vdih se je končal s presenečenim smehom, Illuminara pa je samo poslušala.

scenes.title: Mesto varuhov
paragraphs: *Mardensko omrežje za nujne primere · enaindvajseta minuta*

Central Mercy ni rešila Mardena. Dokazala je, da lahko en mehanizem preživi zavrnitev. Daro je njegove meritve poslal po mestu; prebivalci so imenovali krajevne varuhe, inženirji pa razvrstili nevarnosti zaradi pomanjkanja zraka in požara.

**Kez**  
Kaj naj bo prvo — vrtec ali stolp? Če izberem narobe, je tudi pri vašem pravilu še vedno odločilna moja roka.

**Illuminara**  
Ljudje v notranjosti sporočijo svojo potrebo in delujoče upravljalne mehanizme. Daro objavi vrstni red. Ti izbiraš samo, ali ga boš spoštovala.

**Lio**  
Lahko zavrneš, vendar jim poveš zakaj, oni pa odgovorijo.
Tekstilni stolp je dobil en strešni zračnik. Civili na sodišču so zavrnili lojalistično zahtevo po glavnem vhodu in namesto tega dobili zrak skozi streho.

Oddajna dvorana pod nadzorom pučistov je zatrjevala, da ima šeststo talcev. Njen seznam, razkrit, ko je čistilec Aru Pell dvignil dva prsta in pokazal navzdol, je pokazal 584 zaposlenih in družinskih članov v spodnjih nadstropjih ter šestnajst oboroženih borcev nad njimi.

**Illuminara**  
Naj zrak, voda in zdravila ostanejo v gibanju. Obnovi kletni vod, če civili prosijo. Naj sosedje z dvorišča za perilo zgradijo en izhod, ki jim pripada.

Civili so glasovali prek vzdrževalnega terminala. Kez je obnovila vod za zrak, sosedje pa so namestili dvojno loputo: orožje v zapečateno korito, prazne roke pred kamero, nato pa vrata širine enega človeka, odprta z dvorišča. Aru je ob njih naslikal zeleno črto.
Vsak obnovljeni prag je nosil Kezino ime, svojega notranjega varuha in zapisani razlog. Njen dar ni bil več edina oblast na zemljevidu.

scenes.title: Hodnik, ki ga nihče ni mogel zavzeti
paragraphs: *Hodnik mardenske mestne bolnišnice · devetindvajseta minuta*
Pragovi v lasti prebivalcev so obema vojskama zavrnili bližnjice. Poveljnik Rusk je Kez ponudil trajni nadzor nad vsakim vhodom, če bi odprla en hodnik od zakladnice do reke.

**Rusk**  
Noben otrok ne bo čakal na glasovanje, medtem ko skozi okno prihaja vojak.

**Kez**  
In kdo ima ključ do mene?

**Rusk**  
Nihče. V tem je smisel.
Njegova ponudba je odstranila možnost, da bi kdorkoli ukazoval Kez, vse druge pa pustila v zavetju, ki bi lahko postalo njena celica.

**Illuminara**  
Prej sem poimenovala, kaj čutiš. Motila sem se. Povej mi, kaj je narobe z njegovo ponudbo.

**Kez**  
Mara je lahko zaprla režo. Rusk ji nikoli ne bi dovolil, da se je dotakne.
Kez se je sama soočila s poveljnikom.

**Kez**  
Rečni hodnik ostane zid. Pri vratih na dvorišču za perilo gre orožje skozi korito, ljudje pa odidejo eden za drugim v varno civilno varstvo. Voda in zdravila pridejo ne glede na to, ali sprejmete. Lojalisti dobijo enake pogoje.

**Rusk**  
Od vojakov bi zahtevali, da čistilce prosijo za dovoljenje za hojo.

**Kez**  
Prosimo ljudi, katerih sobe smo spremenili v poti. Tudi jaz bom uporabila njihova vrata, ko bo tega konec.

**Rusk**  
Sodili vam bodo skupaj z njimi.

**Kez**  
Da.

Objavila je vsako odprtino, ki jo je odstranila, vključno s triinštiridesetimi zasedenimi sobami, za katere službe za nujne primere niso vedele, in obnovila samo poti, katerih notranji varuhi so potrdili pripravljenost.
Illuminara je zadrževala eno evakuacijsko črto, medtem ko so delale krajevne ekipe. Sama ni odprla nobenega praga. Sistem ni več potreboval nje — niti Kez — povsod.

scenes.title: Odprto po izbiri
paragraphs: *Prestolnica Marden · od osemintridesete minute do poldneva*

V osemintrideseti minuti je Central Mercy dosegla varno zalogo kisika. Daro se je vrnil z opornico na porezani roki. Ansa mu ni dovolila dvigniti plošče; z zdravo roko se je dotaknil dokončanega zgornjega spoja in ugotovil, da drži.
Triinsedemdeset civilnih hodnikov je zdaj povezovalo bolnišnice, zaklonišča, kuhinje in vodne postaje. Vsakega je bilo mogoče zapreti od znotraj brez Kez ali Illuminare.
Ob 07.41 je Aru preštel 584. civilista, ki je zapustil oddajno dvorano. Šele nato je kamero obrnil proti Rusku.

**Aru**  
Rekli ste, da noben otrok ne bi smel čakati, medtem ko skozi okno prihaja vojak. Ta zapah je znotraj. Vojak pri oknu ga ne more doseči.

**Rusk**  
Kaj pa, če je grožnja vaš varuh?

**Aru**  
Dva imenovana varuha, javna kamera in katerikoli od njiju lahko ustavi vrata. Opazujte, kako to dokažemo, preden se odločite.
En borec je porinil puško v korito. Aru je kamero obrnil proti njegovim praznim rokam. Sosedje so odprli, ga sprejeli v civilno varstvo in ga niso udarili; notranji zapah je ves čas držal.

Rusk je opazoval še tri borce, ki so izbrali isti prehod. Nato je odložil pištolo, pogledal zapah, ki ga noben prihajajoči vojak ni mogel doseči, in stopil skozi manjša vrata. Drugi so mu sledili, vsak po vrsti. Lojalistične enote so pod svojimi civilnimi opazovalci dobile in uporabile enake pogoje.

Reševalci so dosegli tudi Jesso Tol, ki je bila sama v eni izmed triinštiridesetih sob. Izbrala je SAMO ZRAK in zavrnila vrata, dokler sosedje niso namestili zapaha na notranji strani. Ko jih je enkrat sama zaprla, jih je prosila, naj jih znova odprejo.
Do poldneva sta obe poveljstvi sprejeli civilno črto premirja. Hrana, voda in zdravila nikoli niso bili odvisni od razorožitve; boji so se končali po varni poti, ki jo je lahko izbral vsak človek.
Kez je peš prišla v Central Mercy. Ansa je notranjo pregrado obdržala zaprto, dokler Kez pred kamero ni pokazala obeh rok.

**Ansa**  
Vse tukaj ste zaprli brez vprašanja. Lahko vidite Lia. Nikoli več pa ne smete odločati, kdaj se ta vrata odprejo.

**Kez**  
Sprejmem.
Ansa je zavrtela kolo. Kez je sedla poleg Lia, ne da bi se dotaknila njegovih upravljalnih mehanizmov.

**Lio**  
Vrata kleti so res zdržala.

**Kez**  
Tudi reža.

**Lio**  
Spomnila si se obojega.

**Kez**  
Ne dovolj zgodaj.

**Illuminara**  
Dovolj zgodaj za bolnišnico. Ne dovolj zgodaj, da bi izbrisala, kar si storila.

Kez je prosila, naj bolnikoma, ki sta zavrnila prvi preizkus, vrata ostanejo odstranjena. Civilni zapisovalci so prevzeli njen zemljevid in vojaške oddaje. Njeno sojenje bi se začelo po okrevanju; nikomur, ki ga je ogrozila, ni bilo treba hvaliti osebe, ki mu je vrnila zrak.

scenes.title: Vrata rastlinjaka
paragraphs: *Južno okrožje Mardena · skupnostni rastlinjak · naslednja zora*
Tesar je namestil mehanski okvir tam, kjer so vrata rastlinjaka izginila. Njegov zapah je bil znotraj.
Kez je pogledala dvanajstletno Tavi Sol, izvoljeno varuhinjo, in počakala.

**Tavi**  
Zdaj.
Kez je obnovila odprtino. Tavi je dvakrat zaprla in odprla vrata, da bi dokazala, da izbira ostaja njena. Nobena vojska ni prečkala praga; otroci so sadike nesli na svetlobo.
Kez ni bila oproščena niti ni postala varuhinja vseh prihodnjih vrat. Vrnila je moč, ki jo je vzela, in sprejela mesto, v katerem so jo druge roke lahko zavrnile.
Illuminara je s Tavi dvignila zadnji pladenj. Paradižnikove trte so se med zapečatenim dnem upognile, vendar se niso zlomile.

**Tavi**  
Naj jih pustimo odprta?

**Illuminara**  
Ti mi povej.
Tavi je začutila veter, pogledala oblake in pustila vrata odprta dežju.

translation_sl.critic_line: Illuminara zamenja zaščitno polje nad trgom za ročno vrtljivo kolo v odpovedujočem oddelku, mesto, ki ga je zapečatil dar ene ženske, pa znova odpre vrata za vrati, z vsakim zapahom na notranji strani, dokler poveljnik državnega udara po lastni izbiri ne stopi skozi manjša vrata in dvanajstletnica ne pusti rastlinjaka odprtega dežju.
